name: tidal-ts-monorepo
description: tidal-ts — a financial time-series charting library on the pond-ts constellation

scripts.test: turbo run test && vitest run --config vitest.root.config.ts
scripts.verify: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run vocabulary && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run build
scripts.release:dry: pnpm run verify && pnpm -r publish --dry-run --access public --no-git-checks
scripts.release: pnpm run verify && pnpm -r publish --access public
